questions.question:
Select the word-pair that best represents a similar relationship to the one expressed in the pair of words given below.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word.)

Leaf : Oak
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic:** Part and Whole Relationship**.

Here,

Leaf : Oak → **Leaf** is a part of an **Oak Tree**.

Similarly,

Needle : Pine → **Needle **is a part of a Pine Tree.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
Select the option in which the words share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of words.

Dermatologist : Skin
questions.solution:
Dermatologist is the doctor of Skin.

Similarly,

1) Cardiologist is the doctor of Heart.

2) Neurologist is the doctor of Nerves.

3) Nephrologist is the doctor of Kidney.

4) Orthopedist is the doctor of Bones.

Hence, ‘Orthopedist : Bones’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: Myopia : Eye :: Meningitis : ?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Brain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Meningitis**:

 
 
• This refers to** infection or inflammation of meninges resulting in severe headache, vomiting and pain**, and stiffness of the neck.
 
• The brain and spinal cord are surrounded by two meninges in frogs and three meninges in mammals.
 
• The most common **cause of meningitis is the infection of bacteria viz. streptococcus pneumonia**, Neisseria meningitis, and Haemophilus influenza.
 
 
 
• **Myopia**:
 
 
• Myopia is **also known as Nearsightedness**. A person with myopia **can see nearby objects clearly but cannot see distant objects distinctly**.
 
• A person with this defect has the far point nearer than infinity. Such a person may see clearly up to a distance of a few meters.
 
• In a myopic eye, **the image of a distant object is formed in front of the retina and not at the retina itself**.
 
• This defect can be **corrected by using a concave lens** of suitable power.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56ec0a3c9c78060f1d8d50595746edd51bef5cfa438f6c1e10ef10318501b661.png] 

 
• **Kidney**:

 
 
• **Kidneys remove a major part of waste products from the body**.
 
• Kidneys** remove uric acid, urea, ammonia**, NaCl, phosphates, hormones, etc. from blood.
 
• Kidneys help in maintaining the alkaline nature of blood by removing acidic products from the blood.
 
 
 
• **Brain**:
 
 
• The brain lies in the cranium of the skull.
 
• The human brain is composed of about 30 billion neurons.
 
• It **weighs about 1.4 kg** and forms about 98% of the total weight of the Central Nervous System.
 
 
 
• **Liver**:
 
 
• The liver is** the largest gland in the body**.
 
• The **liver produces bile a green-yellow alkaline fluid**.
 
• The liver manufactures urea as a waste product of proteins.

questions.question: ‘War’ is related to ‘Destruction’ in the same way as ‘Cyclone’ is related to ‘______’.
questions.solution:
War leads to destruction. The outcome of war is destruction.

Similarly,

Cyclone causes devastation.

Hence, ‘**Devastation**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: Heat is related to Cold, in the same way Knight is related to ________?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

__
 
• Heat is antonym of Cold.

Similarly, 

 
• Knight is antonym of Coward.

Hence, 'Coward' is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• *Knight - a heroic champion of a lady or of a cause or principle*
 
• *Coward - one who shows fear in the face of danger or pain.*

questions.question:
In the following questions, select the related word from the given alternatives:- 

Planet : Orbit :: Projectile : ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

Planet : Orbit → Orbit is the path followed by a Planet.

Similarly,

Projectile : ? → ? will be the path followed by a projectile.

Now we consider the given options:

Option 1) Track : It is the path followed by a train

Option 2) Milky Way : It is a galaxy.

Option 3) **Trajectory : It is the path followed by a projectile.**

Option 4) Path : a course or direction without any context.

Hence, the correct answer is option (3).

questions.question:
Select the word-pair that best represents a similar relationship to the one expressed in the pair of words given below.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

Modest : Humble
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic:** Synonyms**.

Here,

Modest : Humble → **Modest** and Humble are synonyms.

Similarly,

Obvious : Evident → **Obvious **and Evident are synonyms.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Select the relative word for the second pair from the given alternatives which will replace the question mark following the relation in the first pair

BONE : ORTHOPAEDIST :: CANCER : ______
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is:

BONE → Specialist or the doctor of bones is called ORTHOPAEDIST.

Similarly,

CANCER → Specialist or the doctor of cancer is called ONCOLOGIST.

Hence, **"ONCOLOGIST"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__
